about: Hand-verified Java + Kotlin call sites for scoring the code graph's JVM CALL resolution (CODE-GRAPH D3 JVM set, 2026-09-28), labelled by an independent agent from the Java/Kotlin language rules and the source alone, before any JVM resolver code existed. The unit is a public clone pinned to a commit (see `units`); its root is given to tools/code_graph_yardstick.py by --root, not by code_repos_dir. `file` is relative to the unit; `expect` is the qname really called, a sorted LIST of qnames when the target type exists in several build-flavor source sets (a call from main or a test set reaches every variant; a call from inside flavor F reaches only F's), or null when the true answer is 'no first-party edge' (JDK, Android, androidx, Kotlin stdlib, the external android-library, or a first-party name that is merely shared). qname = <unit-relative path>::<dotted enclosing definitions>.<name>; overloads share one qname; a constructor call expects the class qname; Kotlin companion members sit under <Type>.Companion, top-level and top-level-extension functions under the file path alone; interface and inherited calls expect the declaration in the receiver's static type or its nearest first-party supertype; lambdas, anonymous classes and object expressions are not callers, initializers belong to their class. Each label was verified by reading the call site and the target definition (null labels by searching the clone for the name), with the evidence in `why`; `files` pins the sha256 of every cited call-site file. Stratified, not a random sample: categories are chosen to discriminate between resolvers, so its precision is not the population precision of the codebase. The repository is GPL-2.0; this file holds only paths, line numbers, short call text and hashes.
